name: TAU2Bench
intro: τ²-Bench是一个用于评估在双控环境中对话式AI代理的基准。与现有基准不同，它模拟了AI代理和用户都能使用工具与共享动态环境交互的真实场景。该基准包含一个新颖的电信双控域，一个可程序化创建多样化任务的组合任务生成器，以及一个与环境紧密耦合的可靠用户模拟器。实验表明，从单用户控制到双用户控制的转变会导致代理性能显著下降，这凸显了指导用户所面临的挑战。
org: Sierra, University of Southern California, University of Toronto, UCLA, Princeton University
build_method: LLM生成PRD/模式/工具/单测，人工修正；原子初始化/解法/断言函数组合生成任务并人工完善政策
eval_feature: 双控环境, 人机协作, 动态环境
scale: 3个领域共279个任务；电信114个由2285个组合任务平衡抽取
build_method_en: LLM-generated PRDs, schemas, tools, and unit tests with manual repair; compositional task generation from initialization, solution, and assertion functions; manual policy refinement
eval_feature_en: Dual control, shared dynamic state, assertion-based verification, no-user ablation
intro_en: τ²-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating conversational AI agents in dual-control environments. Unlike existing benchmarks, it simulates realistic scenarios where both AI agents and users can interact with a shared dynamic environment using tools. The benchmark features a novel telecom dual-control domain, a compositional task generator for programmable diverse tasks, and a reliable user simulator tightly coupled with the environment. Experiments show that shifting from single-user control to dual-user control significantly degrades agent performance, highlighting the challenges in guiding users.
scale_en: 279 tasks across three domains; 114 telecom tasks balanced from 2,285 compositions

drawio_review_note: Aligned with τ²-bench arXiv:2506.07982 Sections 3-4 and Appendices A-D; official sierra-research/tau2-bench repository. τ²-bench extends τ-bench with a telecom dual-control domain modeled as a Dec-POMDP in which agent and user have distinct tools acting on shared dynamic state. LLMs generate a product requirements document, agent CRM schema, tool implementations, mock database, and unit tests; humans repair them until tests pass. The same process creates a mocked user phone, its state, and 15 read plus 15 write user tools. Each atomic telecom subtask defines initialization, solution, and assertion functions. At most one subtask from each mutually exclusive group is composed, and generated tasks are automatically checked to require every solution. Fifteen subtask groups across three intents yield 2,285 tasks; 114 are balanced by intent and subtask count. LLMs draft the troubleshooting policy, humans jointly refine tools, policy, and subtasks, and tasks receive None, Easy, or Hard personas. Together with the inherited 115 retail and 50 airline tasks, the paper evaluates 279 tasks. Telecom success is determined by final-state assertions. Each task runs four times at temperature zero; pass^k is reported, and no-user mode gives the agent all tools to separate reasoning errors from communication and coordination errors.
